scope_note: Continuation covering the 6 trials with no output_validated receipt. The 14 trials validated under trial-plan-run2.json are deliberately absent: re-listing them under a new plan hash would orphan their receipts. Evidence for this experiment cites both plans.
supersession_reason: Scoped CONTINUATION of EXP-QSP-70b731 covering only the 6 trials that never produced an output_validated receipt: stage3-bridge-n22, stage4-bandH-n33, stage4-bandH-n44, stage4-bandH-n66, stage-compare-sealed, stage5-controls. The other 14 trials are output_validated under trial-plan-run2.json (sha dd5216a80a83d466bb0886d36f54f11f88ec2ed395e89feff3f32cab8ec87ea5) and remain bound to it. They cannot be carried in this plan: experiment_execution.py:198 recognises a receipt only when receipt.plan_sha256 equals the running plan's hash, so re-listing them here under a new hash would orphan 14 valid measurements while their run directories can never be recreated. The experiment's evidence therefore rests on TWO plans and must cite both explicitly. TWO STRUCTURAL EDITS, both plan-wiring, neither touching a measurement: (1) stage3-bridge-n22.depends_on was ['stage2-bandL-n14'] and is pruned to []. coverage() evaluates states[dep] over the plan's own trials, so a dependency absent from the plan raises KeyError and crashes coverage() outright -- this is a hard requirement, not a preference. The gate is not weakened: stage2-bandL-n14 is output_validated under run2 at RUN-QSP-327529 with returncode 0 and check_returncode 0, so the dependency was already discharged and the pruning records that fact. It is the only cross-plan edge; the remaining five trials chain among themselves. (2) first_wave was ['stage0-hand-gate','stage1-toy-calibration','stage2-bandL-n3'..'n6'], all absent here, and is restated as ['stage3-bridge-n22'], the only trial in this plan with no dependency. Every trial keeps its stable identity, seed and parameters, so stage3-bridge-n22 is a RETRY of a claim-expired attempt, not a new replication; its prior directory RUN-QSP-715b58 (status=claim_expired) and the never-launched RUN-QSP-ebcc71 are consumed/unused and are not reused. specification hash, source hash, ordering, artifacts, watchdogs and stopping rules are carried byte-identical from trial-plan-run2.json. Disclosed cost property: bridge n'=22 consumed roughly three hours unfinished, and Band H {33,44,66} is heavier, so the claim TTL is 2880 minutes. TTL is a coordination parameter, not a scientific budget or sample count. Execution is Linux-only: darwin cannot set RLIMIT_AS at any ceiling.
